interpretation: Misses in both sensor paths, a fusion omission, or a shared sensor-loss event can each defeat detection. Fusion is not an additional independent barrier after both inputs are unavailable. The model does not address false positives, collision dynamics, braking effectiveness, or the entire operating domain.
basis: Authored correction of the preserved gallery hazard model. Boolean event meanings and parameter scenarios are proposed teaching abstractions, not accepted field data.
